definitions.explanation: Poetry and verse considered together as a literary form, covering both Chinese-style poems and Japanese forms such as waka and haiku.

examples.japanese: {詩歌|しいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{愛|あい}する→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{詩歌|しいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|した}しんで→親しむ：14139_shitashimu⟧きた。
examples.english: He has been familiar with poetry since his youth.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詩歌|しいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}く→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}している→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: This magazine introduces a wide range of contemporary poetry.

notes:
A broad term covering poetry and verse as a whole, including ⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧, ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧, and Chinese-style poems. A somewhat formal, literary word. It may also be read かし.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詩歌|しいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詠|よ}む→詠む：14186_yomu⟧: to compose poetry
- {詩歌|しいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|した}しむ→親しむ：14139_shitashimu⟧: to enjoy and become familiar with poetry
- {詩歌|しいか}{管弦|かんげん}: poetry and music (classical arts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧: poem; poetry — usually a single poem or modern free verse
- ⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧: song; waka — in classical contexts refers to ⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧
